text:
nina_finance: Quick question: customer Solaris Labs flagged an unexpected overage on their Dedicated commit (INV-2025-0947). Looks like a Feb 18 burst of $2,450. Can billing/eng confirm if this is billable or eligible for an SLA credit?

raf_billing: I pulled the invoice lines: 
```
Dedicated Reserved - Mar 2025: $12,000
Burst Overage - 2025-02-18: $2,450 (153,400 tokens)
SLA credit applied: $0
```
No auto-credit. We need root cause to decide manual adjustment.

dana_eng: Checked routing/telemetry. There was a scheduled node reboot in us-west-2 at 02:04 UTC and our graceful-failover window misfired, causing about 90s of routed traffic to Dedicated pools. The token spike correlates with 3 long-running sessions from Solaris' app (sess_221a, sess_221b, sess_221c). Looks like a controlled internal maintenance, not customer-induced.

nina_finance: If it was our maintenance, that's our liability. What's the dollar calc?

raf_billing: Overage line shows $2,450. We can either issue a full manual credit or prorate based on time-in-window. Billing system supports full credit or proportional by token minutes.

tom_accounting: For audit, we need: incident ticket, eng postmortem link, and approval from Finance lead. Also include memo describing reason code.

dana_eng: Created infra incident INF-2987 with timeline and mitigation steps. Root cause: maintenance orchestration didn't set ephemeral routing exemption flag, so failover targeted Dedicated. Patch deployed to add exemption flag for scheduled maintenance.

nina_finance: I approve a full credit for this case. Please use reason code DED-MAINT-CHARGE and note "provider-initiated maintenance" in the memo. Also propose a small process change: notify Billing 24h before maintenance that may touch routing.

raf_billing: Will create adjustment ADJ-9372 for $2,450 credit, attach INF-2987 and postmortem. Draft memo: "Credit due to provider-initiated maintenance routing to Dedicated". Also adding DED-MAINT-CHARGE to reason codes.

tom_accounting: Once adj is created, I'll book journal JE-2025-055 in Mar close and attach docs.

billing-bot: Ticket created: BIL-4478 - "Credit ADJ-9372 for INV-2025-0947 (DED-MAINT-CHARGE)". Audit trail ready.

dana_eng: We'll also add a telemetry tag to mark maintenance windows so billing can filter those in future usage exports.

nina_finance: Good. Please also draft a short customer-facing note for Solaris saying we reviewed and issued a full credit; include timeline and preventive steps. CS can send.

raf_billing: Will notify Solaris and include ADJ-9372 and BIL-4478 references. Closing on our side once accounting confirms JE posted.

nina_finance: Thanks team. Low-friction resolution here but let's bake the maintenance-exemption into the runbook so this doesn't repeat. :white_check_mark:
